title: [review] tx_queue.py:318: TOCTOU between expire_stale()
description: expire_stale() at line 318 and ensure_can_push() at line 319 each call self._clock() independently. If an entry's deadline passes between these calls, ensure_can_push() excludes it from active_entries (line 368) but expire_stale() never removed it. When len(active_entries) < capacity but len(self._entries) >= capacity, the code enters preemption path (line 350) and evicts a valid entry, while the truly-expired entry remains queued. Fix: pass a single 'now' timestamp through both methods, or re-run expire_stale() before the preemption path.
